one_line_description.value: Squarespace provides a developer platform and Commerce APIs for managing commerce features on merchant sites.
one_line_description.quote: With Squarespace Commerce APIs, you can build applications to manage the commerce features of a Squarespace merchant site.

has_public_api.quote: Everything you need to build and publish external apps — reliable APIs, clear documentation, and a marketplace to reach Squarespace's global customer base.

api_type.quote: All Commerce APIs are built on HTTPS and designed with REST principles in mind.

api_breadth.value: REST commerce APIs with read/write access to orders, products, inventory, and transactions; webhooks for order events.
api_breadth.quote: Read and write orders, products, inventory, and transactions. REST endpoints, webhooks for order events, and signed payloads for safe server-to-server delivery.

auth_methods.quote: Depending on your development needs, you can use a generated API key or start the OAuth process with Squarespace to become a registered OAuth client.

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: The confirmation page always displays website(s) for user selection for `scope=website.*` `website.orders` Send order data and mark orders as fulfilled. `website.orders.read` View order and fulfillment information.

access_model.quote: Registering an OAuth client, and having it reviewed and approved, only allows OAuth connections with Squarespace.

access_notes.value: Third-party OAuth client registration requires Squarespace review and approval; custom API-key applications require a site on the Commerce Advanced plan, and Extensions listing is a separate process.
access_notes.quote: Registering an OAuth client, and having it reviewed and approved, only allows OAuth connections with Squarespace.

official_mcp_server.quote: Configure a remote MCP server with: - URL:`https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp` - Transport: Streamable HTTP

rate_limits.quote: Refer to the rate limiting guidelines for more information.

webhooks.quote: Subscribe to order, inventory, content, and customer events with signed delivery.

verdict_reason: Squarespace documents public Commerce APIs with OAuth 2.0 and API-key authentication, plus webhooks and an official MCP server. However, third-party OAuth client registration requires Squarespace review/approval, and custom API-key apps are tied to the Commerce Advanced plan, so access is not fully self-serve.
main_blocker: OAuth app review/approval; Commerce Advanced plan for custom API keys
outreach_reason: A third-party developer must register an OAuth client and wait for Squarespace review/approval; custom API-key apps also require the Commerce Advanced plan.
open_questions: What are the numeric Commerce API rate limits? The supplied error-handling page only references rate-limiting guidelines.
Is there a documented sandbox or test environment for Commerce API development? No such source was included in the evidence.
Which official SDKs, if any, does Squarespace maintain? No SDK page was included in the evidence.
What is the API versioning and deprecation policy? The versioning page was not fetched; a search snippet mentioned Products API v2, but snippets are not citable.
For third-party commercial integrations, is OAuth app review the only route, or can Commerce Advanced API keys be used for production apps?
